dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a concave spline curvature with a jagged irregular interruption or notch near the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the vertex, forming a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep posterior inclination of the anterior margin relative to the longitudinal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The horizontal pixel width of the fin base is approximately 1.4 times greater than the vertical pixel height of the apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex curvature forming a smooth arc across the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion extending from the melon inflection point with a high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notch or tissue loss on the posterior-basal margin of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan/teal pixel distribution across the entire morphology, indicating an artificial or rendered surface rather than organic skin.
